```{r }
WTI= read.csv("WTI_OIL.csv")
HHUB=read.csv("HENRY_HUB.csv")

#CONVERT THE FORMAT DATE
WTI$Date <- format(as.Date(WTI$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"), "%Y-%m-%d")
HHUB$Date <- format(as.Date(HHUB$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"), "%Y-%m-%d")

#Convert data in numeric
WTI$Price_oil=as.numeric(WTI$Price_oil)
HHUB$Price_1=as.numeric(HHUB$Price_1)


# Function to replace NA values with the mean of the previous and next values
impute_missing_with_mean <- function(series) {
  for (i in 4:(length(series) - 1)) {
    if (is.na(series[i])) {
      series[i] <- (series[i -2 ] + series[i - 1]) / 2
    }
  }
  return(series)
}

# Apply the imputation function to the specified column in your data frame
WTI$Price_oil <- impute_missing_with_mean(WTI$Price_oil)
HHUB$Price_1 <- impute_missing_with_mean(HHUB$Price_1)
#compute the daily return



```   

```{r include=FALSE}
# List of CSV files to combine
data_list <- list(WTI, HHUB)

# Create an empty data frame to store the combined data
combined_df <- data_list[[1]]

# Read and combine the CSV files while preserving common dates
# Combine data frames while preserving common dates
for (i in 2:length(data_list)) {
  combined_df <- inner_join(combined_df, data_list[[i]], by = "Date")
}

# Save the combined data frame to a new CSV file
write.csv(combined_df, "combined_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
project_Data=read.csv("data_return.csv")

#equal weight
weights=c(0.5, 0.5)
#  calculate portfolio returns
portfolio_returns <- weights[1] * project_Data$WTI_Return + weights[2] * project_Data$HHUB_Return
project_Data$portfolio_returns<-portfolio_returns  
```




```{r}
# Function to calculate GARCH(1,1) volatility
GARCH_volatility <- function(returns, omega, alpha, beta) {
  n <- length(returns)
  sigma <- numeric(n)
  sigma[1] <- sd(returns)
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    sigma[i] <- sqrt(omega + alpha * returns[i-1]^2 + beta * sigma[i-1]^2)
  }
  
  return(sigma)
}

# Set parameters
omega_GARCH <- 0.0001
alpha_GARCH <- 0.1
beta_GARCH <- 0.8

# Calculate GARCH volatility for the portfolio
garch_volatility <- GARCH_volatility(portfolio_returns, omega_GARCH, alpha_GARCH, beta_GARCH)

# Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
confidence_level <- 0.95
z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)

# Calculate VaR for the portfolio
var_garch <- garch_volatility[length(garch_volatility)] * z_score  # Use the last volatility in GARCH

# Calculate the potential loss in dollars
initial_asset_value <- 10e6  # $10 million
potential_loss <- initial_asset_value * var_garch

# Print results
cat("Portfolio GARCH VaR:", var_garch, "\n")
cat("Potential Loss at", confidence_level, "confidence level:", potential_loss, "\n")
```
```{r}
# Function to calculate GARCH volatility and VaR
calculate_garch_var_daily <- function(returns, omega, alpha, beta, confidence_level) {
  n <- length(returns)
  garch_volatility_1<- numeric(n)
  var_garch_1 <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    garch_volatility_1[i] <- sqrt(omega + alpha * returns[i-1]^2 + beta * garch_volatility[i-1]^2)
    
    # Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
    z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
    var_garch_1[i] <- garch_volatility_1[i] * z_score
  }
  
  return(list(volatility = garch_volatility_1, VaR = var_garch_1))
}

# Set parameters
omega_GARCH <- 0.0001
alpha_GARCH <- 0.1
beta_GARCH <- 0.8
confidence_level <- 0.95

# Calculate GARCH volatility and VaR for the portfolio
garch_results <- calculate_garch_var_daily(portfolio_returns, omega_GARCH, alpha_GARCH, beta_GARCH, confidence_level)

# Print results (for example, printing the first 10 values)
cat("Portfolio GARCH Volatility:\n", head(garch_results$volatility, 10), "\n")
cat("Portfolio GARCH VaR:\n", head(garch_results$VaR*initial_asset_value, 10), "\n")


# Function to calculate EWMA volatility and VaR
calculate_ewma_var_daily <- function(returns, lambda, confidence_level) {
  n <- length(returns)
  ewma_volatility <- numeric(n)
  var_ewma <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    ewma_volatility[i] <- sqrt(EMA(returns[i]^2, n = 1, alpha = lambda, wilder = FALSE))
    
    # Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
    z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
    var_ewma[i] <- ewma_volatility[i] * z_score
  }
  
  return(list(volatility = ewma_volatility, VaR = var_ewma))
}

# Set parameters
lambda_EWMA <- 0.94

# Calculate EWMA volatility and VaR for the portfolio
ewma_results <- calculate_ewma_var_daily(portfolio_returns, lambda_EWMA, confidence_level)

# Print results (for example, printing the first 10 values)
cat("Portfolio EWMA Volatility:\n", head(ewma_results$volatility, 10), "\n")
cat("Portfolio EWMA VaR:\n", head(ewma_results$VaR*initial_asset_value, 10), "\n")

```


```{r}
# Function to calculate SMA volatility and VaR
calculate_sma_var_daily <- function(returns, window_size, confidence_level) {
  n <- length(returns)
  sma_volatility <- numeric(n)
  var_sma <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in window_size:n) {
    sma_volatility[i] <- sd(returns[(i - window_size + 1):i])
    
    # Assuming a normal distribution for simplicity
    z_score <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence_level) / 2)
    var_sma[i] <- sma_volatility[i] * z_score
  }
  
  return(list(volatility = sma_volatility, VaR = var_sma))
}

# Set parameters
sma_window_size <- 10

# Calculate SMA volatility and VaR for the portfolio
sma_results <- calculate_sma_var_daily(portfolio_returns, sma_window_size, confidence_level)

# Print results (for example, printing the first 10 values)
cat("Portfolio SMA Volatility:\n", head(sma_results$volatility, 10), "\n")
cat("Portfolio SMA VaR:\n", head(sma_results$VaR*initial_asset_value, 10), "\n")

```
